spans.s:
LORD (subs.):
(1) ईशः,
the L. of the past, the
future, and the present:
भूतभव्यभवदीशः, Ki.;
(2)
ईश्वरः,
the l. of Kāmrupa:
कामरूपेश्वरः, R.: v.
Master. Ph.: ‘my l.’ (as a term of
address) देवः
or
आर्यपुत्रः (by wives)
or
मर्तृ (m.)
(by menial servants): v. Master.

LORD (v.): प्रभुत्वं करोति (with gen.): v. To
domineer, rule.

LORDLY: I. Noble, dignified: q. v.
II
Haughty, imperious: q. v.

LORDSHIP:
I As title: देवः: v. (My) Lord.
II Dominion, power: q. v.: प्रभुत्वम्।
